function.name: get_price_quote
function.description: Get an estimate for a service, optionally with add-ons. Returns the low and high price, whether GST is included, the total duration and a speech-ready sentence.

service_id.description: The service_id from list_services, eg SVC002. A service name also works.

addon_ids.description: item_id values from list_services, eg ["ADD004"]. Omit or empty for none.

messages.content: One moment, let me get that price for you.
